definitions.full: H1903. hagin [ הָגִין ] adjective appropriate, suitable ? (compare Late Hebrew Aramaic, above) — הֲגִינָה הַגְּדֶרֶת Ezek 42:12 the corresponding (?) wall , Ke; otherwise Vrss ( ᵐ5 καλάμου , ᵑ9 separatum , etc.); Thes connects הגין with preceding דֶּרֶךְ , ' aptus, idoneus (de via),' AV RV 'the way directly before the wall;' in neither connection does it give good sense, and the text is doubtless wrong compare Sm Da.; Co conjecture החיצונה החצר the outer court. הגר (√ of following; ?compare Arabic forsake, retire ; emigration, Hegira ).
